auxiliary: log loss and its rotation p
event hits per evaluation episode, lead sessions, false-alarm share, and the hit count's rotation p (opportunity- and persistence-aware null)
Brier skill of M1 and M2 vs M0

baselineFAST.basis: price (inherited unchanged); events use total return
baselineFAST.definition: count of {close < 200-session mean incl. today, 63-session log-return std (ddof 1) x sqrt(252) > 0.25} on SPY split-adjusted raw close; FAST = 0 is normal

m1Features.gap200: close / mean(close over 200 sessions incl. today) - 1
m1Features.vol63: the same 63-session realised volatility FAST thresholds

corroboration.blockBootstrap: REPORTED ONLY: moving blocks of 12 evaluation rows, 9999 draws, seed 20261123, 95% percentile interval of mean dBrier
corroboration.leaveOneEpisodeOut: GATED: evaluation-side, no refit: dBrier with each evaluation episode's positive rows removed must stay > 0 for every episode

decisionTiming.creditInputs: ALFRED vintage in force on the calendar day BEFORE the decision session (H.15/Moody's values released on the decision day arrive after the close); latest observation in it
decisionTiming.decision: after the close of the last XNYS session of each calendar month (US/Eastern)
decisionTiming.etfExecutionForAnyLaterAllocationStudy: next XNYS session close after the decision (t+1); a month-end close is never used as the execution price of its own decision
decisionTiming.labelWindow: sessions t+1 .. t+126 (the first tradable session after a month-end decision is t+1)
decisionTiming.priceInputs: SPY split-adjusted raw close through the decision close

event.episodeEnd: first later session regaining the running peak recorded at the start
event.firstPassage: first session with TR / running peak - 1 <= -0.15 while no episode is active
event.index: SPY total return = raw close + SSGA issuer distributions reinvested at the ex-date close
event.label: 1 if an episode starts in (t, t+126]; 0 if not and 126 sessions remain; else censored (None)

holdConditions.minimumDetectable: smallest planted effect with support-verdict rate >= 0.8 in powerSummary; if none, the design cannot establish support at 80% power for any simulated effect
holdConditions.rule: a non-support verdict is a statement about this design's power, not about credit: the frozen design detects only large effects (see powerSummary); any verdict other than support is reported as 'not detected at this power'

hypothesis.nullHypothesis: Given gap200 and vol63, the credit flag carries no information about the label.
hypothesis.statement: At US month-end decisions where the existing price/volatility model is normal (FAST = 0), the real-time credit signal WIDEN_3M_ABOVE_EXPANDING_P80 improves the 126-session first -15% passage probability over a model using the continuous price information in the normal state.

models.M0: Jeffreys base rate (k + 0.5) / (n + 1) of matured training labels
models.M1: ridge logistic, intercept + standardised [gap200, vol63], lambda 1.0, intercept unpenalised
models.M2: M1 + standardised credit flag, same lambda and standardisation (training-window mean/sd; a zero-variance column is set to 0)
models.noTuning: no hyperparameter search; lambda, horizon, thresholds and windows are fixed here

powerSummary.design: stage2_design.primary + bootstrap + LOEO + verdict, synthetic credit and price features

preOutcomeRevisions.basis: synthetic power only (evidence/stage2-power-revision0-with-bootstrap-gate.json); no real credit value met any label
preOutcomeRevisions.change: the block-bootstrap lower bound > 0 condition was removed from the support verdict and kept as a reported interval
preOutcomeRevisions.reason: with about 11 blocks over 5 evaluation episodes the bound passed 3.5% of null worlds and only 35% of worlds with a planted relative risk of about 6.6, where rotation passed 82% and leave-one-episode-out 72.5%; it was the binding gate and an unreliable instrument at this sample size. Rotation + leave-one-episode-out keeps the null support rate at 4.5%.

primary.exchangeability: assumes the flag process is stationary enough that its alignment with the calendar is exchangeable under H0; preserves persistence, FAST mask, labels and M1 exactly
limitations: tests independence of the flag from the label process, which is stronger than conditional independence given M1; a flag correlated with gap/vol but uninformative beyond them is still a valid null case because it is re-fitted with M1 present
rotation joins regimes across the wrap point; the expanding-percentile flag is not exactly stationary (its first years are noisier)
primary.null: circular rotation of the defined credit-flag sequence (337 months), shifts 12..325 (314); M2 refitted per shift; one-sided p = (1 + #{null >= observed}) / (1 + 314)
primary.statistic: dBrier = mean(Brier(M1) - Brier(M2)) over evaluation rows

sample.commonSample: month-end decisions >= 1997-01-31, in the risk set, FAST = 0, flag defined

secondaryNotRealTime: purged leave-one-episode-out cross-validation over all labelled common-sample rows (7 episodes), descriptive dBrier only; it trains on the future and decides nothing

signal.change: as-of spread(decision month m) - as-of spread(m - 3); each value from its own decision's vintage
signal.flag: change > numpy linear-interpolated 0.80 quantile of ALL strictly earlier defined changes; at least 12 earlier defined changes; otherwise undefined
signal.name: WIDEN_3M_ABOVE_EXPANDING_P80
signal.selectedIn: Stage 1, by alarm budget and coverage only, before any credit-label relation was read
signal.spread: BAA - GS10 from the two month-end as-of ledgers; missing when either leg is missing or the two legs' observation months differ (BAA stall 2016-11..2017-02 is missing, never filled)
signal.undefinedHandling: rows with an undefined flag are excluded from BOTH M1 and M2 (common sample)

stage3Authorization.oneShot: marker written before the first real credit value meets a label; any failure after it consumes the study; no rerun, reseed or threshold change

verdictRules.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: the outcome-free structure gate fails (fewer than 3 evaluation episodes, 100 evaluation rows or 100 rotations)
verdictRules.DIRECTIONAL_NOT_SEPARATED: dBrier > 0 and either other condition fails
verdictRules.EXPLORATORY_INCREMENTAL_SUPPORT: dBrier > 0 AND rotation p <= 0.05 AND dBrier > 0 with every single evaluation episode removed
verdictRules.NOT_DETECTED_UNDERPOWERED: dBrier <= 0; never reported as evidence that credit has no effect
verdictRules.ceiling: no verdict is confirmatory; confirmation requires prospective receipts

walkForward.evaluationRows: labelled common-sample rows from the evaluation start
walkForward.evaluationStart: first year whose training set has >= 20 rows and positives from >= 2 episodes (observed: 2001)
walkForward.refit: once a year at the first month-end session of the year (from the calendar)
walkForward.training: common-sample rows whose 126-session label window ended on or before the refit session; an early-resolved positive is not used early
